description: This script manages the lifecycle of review cycles for software components via modification of metadata YAML files, providing commands to start, stop, or clear review dates, and printing help information.

methods.name: list_components
methods.description: Lists all components by locating metadata.yaml files excluding documentation and scripts directories.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays help message and lists available components.

methods.name: resolve_metadata
methods.description: Resolves the path to a component's metadata.yaml file.

methods.name: add_business_days
methods.description: Adds a specified number of business days to a given date.

methods.name: clear_dates
methods.description: Clears review lifecycle dates in a metadata.yaml file.

methods.name: regen_report
methods.description: Regenerates the RAG report by invoking an external script.
